_doc: Bosch Rexroth's swivel-in sliding block with spring for its 8 mm slot, M8 (3 842 529 297). Fmax is Rexroth's for the M8.
name: slot-nut-8-bosch-m8-roll-in

slot.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

thread.rule: Thread M8, one of the sizes the table lists (M4, M5, M6, M8)
thread.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

nut_kind.rule: Swivelled in through the opening; a spring holds it where it is put
nut_kind.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

length.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

width.rule: Across the slot: the drawing gives no figure; taken 0.5 mm under the 16.5 mm cavity
width.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9: not dimensioned there, so an estimate

height.rule: The body under the lips: h = 4.8 less h1 = 1.0 in the table
height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

tongue_height.rule: The step into the opening: h1 = 1.0 in the table
tongue_height.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot
nut_entry.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9

hold.rule: Fmax 2200 N, as the catalogue rates it for the 8 mm slot (M8): the pull straight out of the slot
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-9
